request.style: English, Female solo voice, ethereal, solo with Celtic choir, acoustic guitar, fiddle, harp, bodhran, warm and reverent mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He lifted his eyes to the high blue sky
The hour has come, the Son is nigh
Glorify the Son in the Father's sight
So the Son may shine with infinite light

[Pre-Chorus]
Authority over all flesh is given
To hold the souls that are striven

[Chorus]
This is eternal life to know
The only true God, nothing less than so
And Jesus Christ whom He has sent
In whom our deepest hope is spent

[Verse]
On earth He glorified the Father's name
Finished the work that He would claim
The glory He held before the world began
Now in Your presence, let it span

[Chorus]
This is eternal life to know
The only true God, nothing less than so
And Jesus Christ whom He has sent
In whom our deepest hope is spent

[Bridge]
Revealed the name to those You chose
Out of the world, in faithful pose
They kept Your word, they held it tight
Guided by the holy light

[Chorus]
This is eternal life to know
The only true God, nothing less than so
And Jesus Christ whom He has sent
In whom our deepest hope is spent

[Outro]
Know the only true God
And the Christ He sent
